label: Correct move: P.Correct m: the move m is correct by the grammar of the practice P, that is, it is…
definition: `P.Correct m`: the move m (an affirmation, confession or condemnation made in the practice) is correct by the grammar of the practice P, that is, it is a move the practice's rules make right, not merely one some participant makes.
note: Analytical vocabulary for the fideist bundle (#1010): 'grammar' in the Wittgensteinian sense the SEP entries report. It fixes no theory of what makes a move correct; the internal-grammar thesis supplies one direction.
